# Team On Time

> Team On Time is a professional website development, web design, Shopify engineering, and digital solutions company established in 2014 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Operating with an in-house technical team of 23 Senior Technical Specialists (zero freelance outsourcing), Team On Time delivers bespoke websites, high-converting Shopify & Shopify Plus stores, custom web applications, and technical SEO for direct growth brands as well as white-label engineering pods for digital agencies worldwide.

## Who Team On Time Serves

- **Direct Growth Brands & Businesses:** Enterprise and mid-market companies needing high-speed custom websites, bespoke Shopify storefronts, ecommerce platforms, and web applications that rank and convert.
- **Digital & Creative Agencies:** Web design, ecommerce, branding, and marketing agencies seeking dependable white-label engineering capacity and dedicated developer pods under strict bilateral NDA.

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. **Website Development:** Custom, semantic, responsive business and corporate websites engineered for sub-second speeds, Core Web Vitals optimization, modular architecture, and zero builder bloat.
2. **Website Design & UI/UX:** User-centric Figma design systems, wireframing, UX research, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and accessible interfaces.
3. **Shopify & Shopify Plus Engineering:**
   - Shopify Store Development: Full-cycle setup, Online Store 2.0 architecture, Checkout Extensibility, and custom app integration.
   - Shopify Custom Theme Development: Bespoke Liquid theme engineering from scratch, tailored section schemas, and speed-first code.
   - Shopify Migration Services: Replatforming from WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, or custom platforms with 100% data fidelity and protected SEO rankings.
   - Shopify Maintenance & Speed Optimization: Retainer-based continuous monitoring, bug resolution, Core Web Vitals remediation, and security updates.
4. **Ecommerce Development:** Scalable multi-currency online stores, custom WooCommerce engineering, payment gateway integrations, and ERP/CRM connections.
5. **Custom Web Application Development:** Client portals, internal operations dashboards, SaaS MVPs, REST/GraphQL APIs, and database engineering.
6. **Technical SEO & Search Engineering:** Code-level crawl optimization, server log diagnostics, schema.org entity graphs, Core Web Vitals, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO).
7. **Agency White-Label & Dedicated Engineering Pods:** 160 hours/month senior developer pods working under bilateral confidentiality covenants.

## Operating Verification & Trust Signals

- **Founding Year:** 2014 (12+ years continuous operations).
- **Engineering Team:** 23 In-House Senior Technical Specialists (no freelance intermediaries).
- **Quality Assurance:** Proprietary 42-Point Pre-Flight QA Protocol enforced across every deployment.
- **Communication SLA:** Guaranteed sub-15-minute Slack & direct messaging response times during operational hours.
- **Headquarters:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
- **Primary Contacts:** partners@teamontime.com | Phone: 9998585682 (+91 99985 85682).
- **Commercial Policy:** All projects are custom-scoped following technical discovery; no arbitrary public price tables.
